# External and curated tables

`GSE215789_sample_name_mapping.json` is not included (no data files are). It maps plasma/serum sample titles to GEO accessions. Notebook 2.1 cell 31, which would rebuild it by scraping GEO HTML, is commented out. The saved JSON is the input the preprocessing actually uses.

Local copies of the tables Notebook 11 reads are in this folder:

- `mirTarBase_cleaned.csv`
- `Predicted_Targets_Info.default_predictions.txt`
- `HMDD_val_data_miRNA.csv`
- `genecards_val_data.csv`
- `CTD_val_data_genes.csv`

These files are not distributed with the repository. Download them from the respective resources.
